name: Mesagne (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mesagne (a palm tree on blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI MESAGNE in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Mesagne, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Mesagne arms — palm tree on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI MESAGNE arched above the arms
